description: List stored Carbone templates with filtering, search, and pagination. Filter by Template ID, Version ID, category, or upload origin. Use includeVersions to see the full version history of each template. Supports cursor-based pagination for large collections. Each result carries its `tags`: to find templates by tag, keep the results whose `tags` include it (list_tags lists the tags in use). Note: templates uploaded with versioning disabled appear with id = null and are identified only by their versionId — pass that versionId where a Template ID is expected (e.g. delete_template, download_template).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response nextCursor field. Use to fetch the next page.

id.description: Filter by Template ID (64-bit format). Cannot be a Version ID.

includeVersions.description: If true, returns all versions for each template. Default: false (only deployed version).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, between 1 and 100 (Carbone API limit). Default: 100. Use cursor to page beyond that.

origin.description: Filter by upload origin: 0 = API, 1 = Carbone Studio, 2 = Salesforce integration, 3 = Odoo integration, 4 = HubSpot integration. Templates uploaded through this MCP server are origin 0.

search.description: Fuzzy search in template names, or exact match on Template ID / Version ID.

name: list_templates

hasMore.description: Whether more results are available via the cursor.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next list_templates call.

title: List Templates
